properties.name: Gherlan's Workshop
properties.note: Gherlan's workshop: the mad inventor and recluse works alone in the Kharse mountains, on the edge of the desert.

properties.name: The Table
properties.note: A flat rock set atop two others, like a table: a Sahuagin altar to Shokath, the shark god. It stands on the western hill, 'the flat place' where, the sea-birds say, others bring their prey.

properties.name: Boar Cave
properties.note: On the eastern hill, toward the rising sun: the lair of two giant dire boars, the 'king and queen' of the sea-birds' tale. A small hidden chamber holds clay jars of old coin (Selladorian, elven, dwarven and Atman) and a worn painting of islands, one above the rest hurling lightning.

properties.name: Andros' Lab
properties.magicNote: Supernaturally chilly, even for its latitude: Thanatos is an island of undeath, and magical cold seems to permeate it.

properties.name: Wreckage of the Sun Chaser
properties.magicNote: Supernaturally chilly, even for its latitude: Thanatos is an island of undeath, and magical cold seems to permeate it.

properties.name: The Wailing Rock
properties.note: A lone rock standing out of open water east of Grand Isle, about 20 feet across. The pencil map marks it with a small ringed symbol.

properties.name: Lenarte Farmstead
properties.basis: a few days north and west of Hagensport, at the edge of the woods, with the Border Mountains far to the west (campaign chapter 1)
properties.note: The farm of Alwin and Katheline Lenarte, a few days north and west of Hagensport at the edge of the woods; on a clear day the Border Mountains can be seen far to the west. Found abandoned in 3121 AA, its animals slaughtered; Alwin was killed by a gnoll vampire.

properties.name: Hearthden
properties.basis: Silvermane gnoll village deep in the woods north of Hagensport (campaign chapter 1)
properties.note: A Silvermane gnoll village deep in the woods. The adventurers were exiled from here after the death of the elder Reka-Heh.

properties.name: Caer Yar-Ahn-Og
properties.basis: a cave in the gnoll woods east of Hearthden (campaign chapter 1)
properties.note: The Bone Fields. An ancient cave of the Silvermane gnoll druids, where they bury their dead and honour their ancestors. It holds a portal to Faerie, which draws the plague-bringer Seth Cailyn. Inside are the Bone Fields, the Cistern Cave, the maze of the Anastomosing, and lush fey caverns.

properties.name: Aillfar
properties.basis: port city on the north-west coast of Lochlainn, north-west of Caer Ordaich-Uaine (campaign chapters 6 and 8)
properties.note: Port city on the north-west coast of Lochlainn, north-west of Caer Ordaich-Uaine. Skellig Rath lies a day's sail away.

properties.name: Caer Ordaich-Uaine
properties.basis: the fortress at the centre of northern Lochlainn (campaign chapter 6)
properties.note: The fortress at the centre of northern Lochlainn, built in the ruins of the old fortress city Casadh-Abhainn. Headquarters of the Green Order, founded 75 years ago to heal the land after the Ruin. Its walls are overgrown with vines and trees, and it is the only safe place for many miles in any direction.

properties.name: Galiad
properties.basis: a small city in central Lochlainn (campaign chapter 6)
properties.note: A small city in central Lochlainn, wiped out in 2978 AA during the Ruin.

properties.name: Castle McKrae
properties.basis: on a mountain of the Lonial range, the old lands of Clan McKrae (campaign chapters 6 and 7)
properties.note: Also called the Devil's Ruin. The castle stood on a mountain of the Lonial range, in the old lands of Clan McKrae, both in this world and in hell. Its ruined halls lead down to an underground lake where the young green dragon Kozgoroth lived. The ruined streets of Daerunbrae lie below it. The first key to Storm Tower was kept here.

properties.name: The Collapse
properties.note: An underwater place about seven days' sailing west and a little south of Agrea. The ruined Akanosi Library District lies on the sea floor above it, and caves below hold the Aboleth Ubel'gorath, its skum, and Tola of the council, taken prisoner. The sleeping Embrian lies in the depths beside the time-lost ruins.

properties.editNote: Built among volcanic mountains; its cliffs look out over the Inner Sea to the north.
properties.magicNote: Much warmer than its latitude and mountains would suggest: active volcanoes and hot springs heat the city and the land around it, so the ground steams, snow does not lie, and winters are mild.
